key_insight: OptScientist discovers compact symbolic optimization laws that explain observed behavior as the outcome of an underlying optimization problem.
engineering_relevance: The framework could help engineers infer interpretable objectives and constraints from data rather than only fit input–output relationships.
method: Learn to represent observed data as an optimization problem, then extract its symbolic form.
Use an LLM agent to integrate literature priors, discover candidate laws, and abstract mechanisms.
Suggest new data to collect for further discovery.
evidence_signal: On the 99-problem OptFeynman benchmark, OptScientist recovers over 80% of ground-truth laws; human risky-choice and monetary-policy evaluations show competitive held-out prediction with few parameters.
watch_item: Predictive accuracy alone does not establish that a discovered objective or constraint is the true underlying mechanism.
paper_title: OptScientist: Automated Discovery of Optimization Laws
